_note: Per-operator settings (operator_ref, service_day_start_hour, ...) live in operators.json.

gps_end_snap._note: build_day.py SNAP: a GPS end ('ליד …') moves to the planned last stop only when gps_km >= share * km_plan, the last point is <= max_km (air) from the stop and not past it along the route (before_tol_km), and the time to the next trip covers the rest at the line's planned speed; start mirrored (first point within start_share of the route, <= start_max_km). Otherwise marked trunc_end/trunc_start ('קטיעה אפשרית'). Any trip lost before its stop counts as completed only without a contradiction (build_day.py contra): its next trip leaves within contra_next_km of the GPS end and not from the stop, or there is no time to finish and reach the next trip.

google_check._note: tools/google_route_check.py: each flagged empty-leg pair (route warning: detour / suspect route) is routed by Google Routes (DRIVE, TRAFFIC_UNAWARE). Close = |google - ours| <= max(tol_pct % of ours, tol_km): marked 'אומת מול גוגל' (table route_google, ok=true), not counted as a problem; otherwise stays for a manual check with Google's km beside ours. Answers cached per origin/destination; stops at monthly_cap / daily_cap calls (below the free tier), counted in the shared ledger of traveltime.

gps_heading._note: build_day.py HEAD: an empty leg from/to a raw GPS point ('ליד …') is routed with the SIRI heading of that point as an OSRM bearing (+- tol_deg, snapped within radius_m; 15 m keeps it off a parallel road such as Begin next to Golda Meir; heading 0 = unknown, not used), so it leaves on the bus's carriageway. First the point is moved onto the line's own road: the ride's licensed shape (MOT GTFS, cache/gtfs_shapes_<slug>.json) within line_m, or within shape_m when the ride's own trace_n previous (next) GPS points are on the shape too; without a shape, OSRM between the two licensed stops around it, checked against those GPS points. The heading is that road's direction there (no line road: from the previous GPS point, else SIRI); when that route has a U-turn/revisit or OSRM has none, the usual routing is used.

route_dev._note: build_day.py DEV: a trip is marked 'סטייה מהמסלול ברישוי' when its own GPS points are farther than m from its licensed shape (MOT GTFS) over more than run_m of driving and it is back on the shape after (David, 18.11.2026: 150 / 250 / 400 m not decided yet; 250 meanwhile).

shape_guard._note: build_day.py SHAPE_GUARD: an empty leg from a GPS point on the line's road to (within near_km of) the line's last stop that is >= ratio x and >= min_km longer than the rest of the shape is routed along the shape; when that fails the build fails.
